name: vital-arcs
title: Vital Arcs
description: A daily summary widget: concentric arcs sweep from the corner with values at their tips, round a score disc.

perf.budget: The arcs are trimmed Skia paths and the badges ride them with UI-thread timings; the score counts up for about a second. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Arcs, badges and the score appear at their values without sweeping or counting.
a11y.screenReader: Each row reads as one line ("Sleep time: 7h 2m, up 12%"), and the arcs as one summary with the score ("16 PAI. Activity 31, Workouts 84, Rest 53").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { VitalArcs } from '@/components/kinetik/vital-arcs';

<VitalArcs
  title="Today · 21 Feb"
  metrics={[
    { icon: <MoonIcon />, value: '7h 2m', label: 'Sleep time', change: { text: '12%', up: true } },
    { icon: <HeartIcon />, value: '56 bpm', label: 'Avg. heart rate' },
  ]}
  rings={[
    { value: 31, label: 'Activity' },
    { value: 84, label: 'Workouts' },
    { value: 53, label: 'Rest' },
  ]}
  score={16}
  scoreLabel="PAI"
/>;
```

## When to use

- A home-screen style summary: two or three figures and up to three goals with a headline score.

## When not to use

- Exact comparisons between rings: the arcs read as progress, not precise values.
- More than three goals: use Activity Rings or a chart.

## Notes

- Ring values run 0–100. They sweep in outside first and re-sweep whenever a value changes.
- Default arc colours are sky, green and red, outside in; pass `color` per ring to change them.
- The card is 204 pt tall and shrinks the arcs on narrow widths so they stay clear of the text.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add vital-arcs`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
